title: TUI relay-roles view and recommend for the selected slice
lead: An overlay shows the relay role matrix as `relay-roles show` prints it, and for the selected slice asks well-specified yes/no and split yes/no, then shows `recommend`'s row per role.
findings_note: owner request, session 2026-10-14: bring the TUI up to date with recent CLI features
boundary: **Not in this slice:** editing the matrix from the TUI. Rows and rules change only through the `relay-roles` commands.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: s256–s268 made the role matrix project state with `show` and `recommend`, and none of it has a TUI surface. Choosing roles for a slice means leaving the TUI. `roles.recommend` (`src/slicer/roles.py:254`) and `roles.render_markdown` (line 319) are pure and can be called directly.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/tui.py`: a `roles` mode with a binding in `BINDINGS` (line 30). The overlay lines are `roles.render_markdown` output. A two-question prompt reuses the `note` prompt pattern (`_note`, line 908), then shows one line per role: role, row id, agent, vendor, model, reasoning, or `(no matching row)`. A project without a matrix shows the `no_relay_roles` message that names `relay-roles init`.
- `docs/tui.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `tests/test_tui.py`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `test_Roles_NoMatrix_NamesRelayRolesInit`
- `test_Roles_Overlay_MatchesRelayRolesShow`: the same lines as `relay-roles show` text.
- `test_Roles_Recommend_SameRowsAsCli` for yes/no and no/yes.
- `test_Roles_Recommend_ProseRow_Refused`
- `test_Roles_Esc_WritesNothing`

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests and watch them go red.
2. Add the mode, the overlay and the prompt.
3. Update the docs and CHANGELOG.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - The affected tests, then the full suite. `slicer check` passes.
